subject.title: fix(daemon): refuse duplicate launchd gateway managers

question: Should user LaunchAgent lifecycle operations fail closed on unverifiable system LaunchDaemon state, including when an operator supplies `--force`, or only on a confirmed same-label conflict?
rationale: Both choices are technically viable but differ in upgrade and operator-recovery behavior; the repository policy treats fallback and fail-closed behavior as a product decision rather than an implementation convenience.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed ownership protection
options.body: Keep the branch policy so uncertain system ownership cannot create or reactivate a competing user manager, with the current contextual recovery guidance.

options.title: Block confirmed conflicts only
options.body: Revise the guard to preserve existing lifecycle behavior for probe failures while refusing only positively identified same-label system ownership.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-closed ownership protection
recommendation.body: Keep the branch policy so uncertain system ownership cannot create or reactivate a competing user manager, with the current contextual recovery guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and contributed the conflict-guard direction on the branch.
